macros.name: getproblem
macros.doc: \getproblem{⟨file⟩} reads in the puzzle from the sudoku file ⟨file⟩ and initialises the solution.

macros.name: hideprogress
macros.doc: The \hideprogress declaration switches off the displays.

macros.name: keepreducing
macros.doc: \keepreducing performs simple reductions on all the cells until either the puzzle is solved or no changes have been made.

macros.name: reduceallcells
macros.doc: \reduceallcells examines all 81 cells, eliminating solution digits from the binary solution sets of the other cells in the row, column, and box.

macros.name: sudokusolve
macros.doc: The macro \sudokusolve{⟨file⟩} attempts to find a solution to the puzzle in the sudoku file ⟨file⟩.

macros.name: writegame
macros.doc: \writegame writes out a (partially) solved puzzle to the sudoku file \sudsolnfile (default sud.out).
